definitions: A coffee drink with chocolate syrup added, or a serving thereof.
A flavour that combines coffee and chocolate.
Of a dark brown colour, like that of mocha coffee.

The application of rituals or actions, especially those based on occult knowledge, to subdue or manipulate natural or supernatural beings and forces in order to have some benefit from them. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
The supernatural forces which are drawn on in such a ritual.
Having supernatural talents, properties or qualities attributed to magic.
Producing extraordinary results, as though through the use of magic.

blocks.text: A magic is a coffee drink made with steamed milk and a double ristretto—a shot of espresso pulled early—that is associated with the Australian city of Melbourne. It is served in a 120 to 150 mL cup, around three-quarters the size of a flat white or latte. Writing in 2014, the food journalist Matt Holden described the magic as "a little less milky, a little more coffee-ish than a latte". According to Holden, the magic is what New Zealanders know as a particular preparation of the flat white.
